layout.hierarchy: Title dominates at top in large red font. Definition box and Meaning section are secondary. Formula box is prominent. Decision trees and confusion matrices on right are visually significant with colored nodes. Body text is black sans-serif.

visual_elements.description: First confusion matrix (top): Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, Actual N. Cell (P,P): TP on green background. Cell (P,N): FN on red background. Cell (N,P): FP on red background. Cell (N,N): TN on green background.

Second confusion matrix (middle right): Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, Actual N. Cell (P,P): 30 inside blue circle. Cell (P,N): 0. Cell (N,P): 70. Cell (N,N): 0 on green background.
Decision tree labeled 'Positive': Root node orange circle '30'. Left branch to orange circle '30' labeled 'TP' below. Right branch to green circle '0' labeled 'FN' below.
Decision tree labeled 'Negative': Root node green circle '70'. Left branch to green circle '0' labeled 'TN' below. Right branch to red circle '70' labeled 'FP' below.
Red-bordered formula box containing 'Recall =' and fraction 'TP / TP + FN'
Blue-bordered box at bottom left with 'Model Try to catch ALL Positive Samples' and '(Irrespective of classifying NEGATIVE Objects as Positive)'
Two speech bubbles with green curly brace underneath labeled 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset'. Left bubble: 'Positive Classified as +ive'. Right bubble: 'Positive Classified as -ive'.

Small airplane icon above Negative decision tree
